old: If you separately opt in to receive transactional SMS messages from Uber related to setting up your Uber account, you agree to receive text messages from Uber at the mobile number you provide. These messages may include messages related to account registration, verification, and other steps necessary to complete the account setup process. Message frequency will vary based on your interactions with Uber and the account setup process.
Message and data rates may apply.

You may opt out of these transactional SMS messages by replying **STOP 1**. Uber will process your opt-out request as required by applicable law, and you may receive a final message confirming your opt-out.
For additional information, reply **HELP** or contact Uber through Customer Support \[https://www.uber.com/us/en/contact/\].
Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

For information about how Uber collects, uses, and shares information in connection with these SMS messages, please review Uber’s Privacy Notice \[https://www.uber.com/global/en/privacy-notice-drivers-delivery-people/\].

new: These terms ("Agent Terms") apply if you, directly or indirectly, use, authorize, or deploy an Agent to access or interact with the Services. An "Agent" is any software, tool, or service that takes autonomous or semi-autonomous action on behalf of, or at the direction of, any person or entity. These Agent Terms are not intended to restrict accessibility tools, such as screen readers, that help individuals with disabilities use the Services.

Agents must operate openly and honestly. An Agent must identify itself as an Agent and operate in accordance with the requirements of these Agent Terms. Specifically, in all HTTP/HTTPS requests, an Agent must identify that the request is from an Agent, and Agents must not solve CAPTCHAs. If Uber asks an Agent to stop accessing the Services, the Agent must stop immediately and may not resume without Uber's permission.
